units.source_text: 源氏公子听到鸣弦声，便想象宫中的情况：

en.t: Prince Genji heard the sound of the bowstring being twanged and imagined what was happening inside the palace:

units.source_text: “此刻巡夜人大概已经唱过名了。

en.t: By now, the night watchmen have probably already called out their names.

units.source_text: 禁卫武士鸣弦，正是这时候吧。”

en.t: This must be just about the time when the guards twang their bowstrings.

units.source_text: 照此推想，还没夜深。

en.t: Judging from that, the night was not yet far advanced.

units.source_text: 他回到房间里，暗中摸索一下，夕颜照旧躺着，右近俯伏在她身旁。

en.t: He went back into the room and felt about in the dark; Yugao was still lying as before, and Ukon was prostrate beside her.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“你怎么啦？

en.t: Prince Genji said, What is the matter with you?

units.source_text: 用不着这么胆怯！

en.t: There is no need to be so frightened!

units.source_text: 荒野地方，狐狸精之类的东西出来吓人，原是可恶的；

en.t: In a desolate place, it is certainly hateful when fox spirits and such things come out to frighten people;

units.source_text: 可是我在这里，不要怕这些东西！”

en.t: but I am here, so do not be afraid of such things!

units.source_text: 便用力把右近拉起来。

en.t: Then he pulled Ukon up with some force.

units.source_text: 右近说：“太可怕了，我心里很不舒服，所以俯伏在地。

en.t: Ukon said, It was so terrifying, and I felt so ill at heart, that I lay face down on the floor.

units.source_text: 小姐现在不知怎么样了？”

en.t: I do not know what has happened to my lady now.

units.source_text: 公子说：“唉，这是怎么一回事！”

en.t: The prince said, Ah, what in the world is this!

units.source_text: 暗中伸手把夕颜抚摸一下，气息也没有了。

en.t: In the dark he reached out and touched Yugao; even her breathing was gone.

units.source_text: 再把她的身体摇一下，但觉四肢松懈，全无神志。

en.t: He shook her body again, but her limbs only felt limp, and she showed no consciousness at all.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“她真是个孩子气的人，被妖魔迷住了吧。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, She is truly childlike; perhaps she has been bewitched by some demon.

units.source_text: 然而束手无策，焦灼万状。

en.t: Yet he had no means to help her and was frantic with anxiety.

units.source_text: 那个禁卫武士拿纸烛来了。

en.t: The guard came carrying a paper torch.

units.source_text: 此时右近已经吓得不能动弹。

en.t: By this time, Ukon was so frightened that she could not move.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便亲自把旁边的帷屏拉过来，遮住了夕颜的身体，对武士说：

en.t: Prince Genji himself pulled over the screen beside them to cover Yugao's body, and said to the guard:

units.source_text: “把纸烛拿过来些！”

en.t: Bring the paper torch closer!

units.source_text: 然而武士遵守规矩，不敢走近，在门槛边站住了。

en.t: But the guard, observing proper rules, did not dare come closer and stopped by the threshold.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“再拿过来些！

en.t: Prince Genji said, Bring it still closer!

units.source_text: 守规矩也要看情况！”

en.t: Even propriety must yield to the situation!

units.source_text: 拿纸烛一照，隐约看见刚才梦中那个美女坐在夕颜枕边，

en.t: When the paper torch was held up to shine, he dimly saw the beautiful woman from his dream sitting by Yugao's pillow,

units.source_text: 倏忽之间便消失了。

en.t: and in an instant she vanished.
